<!-- Source page: Firefox Sync Server -->

[Firefox Sync Server](https://nixos.org/manual/nixos/stable/#module-services-firefox-syncserver) is sync server for <a href="Firefox" class="wikilink" title="Firefox">Firefox</a> browsers for self-hosting.

It is documented in the [NixOS manual](https://nixos.org/manual/nixos/stable/#module-services-firefox-syncserver).
